paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word. The values are averaged over the tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for different language models, mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM, across various relative positions to a probed target word. The vertical axis represents the “Shapley value” and ranges from 0 to 80, using a linear scale with tick intervals of 10. The horizontal axis displays relative positions, labeled L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, and R3+, and these labels represent the positions of the target word relative to other words in the input sequence. The bars are stacked, with blue representing mBERT, gray representing XLM-R, teal representing chLSTM, and light green representing chLSTM. The tallest bar, corresponding to the position L1, for mBERT, reaches a value of approximately 65. The shortest bar, corresponding to the position R3+, for XLM-R, has a value of approximately 10. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
